notes.title: Version 0.2.4
notes.content:
[h2][u]Balance Adjustments:[/u][/h2]
- Attacking the player is now only possible if there are no opposing cards on the field.
- Attacking directly on the first turn is no longer possible.

[h2][u]Steam items can now be found after a match.[/u][/h2]
- Up to 10 items can be found.
- Currently, there are 2 items for attack animations (not yet functional in the game).

Chances:
- 95% chance for "Curve Animation"
- 5% chance for "Boomerang Animation"

These items can be sold for Steam Credits on the Community Marketplace.

notes.title: Version 0.2.0
notes.content:
[h1][u]New mechanic: Class membership
[/u][/h1]

Every single card now belongs to a class. Combined cards can therefore have a total of 2 classes if they have been combined with two different classes.

There are the following classes and the active effects become stronger the more of them there are on the field:

[list]
[*] Living creature
[olist]
[*] +1 attack
[*] +2 attack
[*] +3 attack
[/olist]
[*] Object
[olist]
[*] +1 life
[*] +2 life
[*] +3 life
[/olist]
[*] Human structure
[olist]
[*] -1 damage
[*] -2 damage
[*] -3 damage
[/olist]
[*] Event
[olist]
[*] 1 damage at the end of the turn
[*] 2 damage at the end of the turn
[*] 3 damage at the end of the turn
[/olist]
[*] Concept/ idea
[olist]
[*] 20% chance of another card
[*] 40% chance of another card
[*] 60% chance of another Card
[/olist]
[*] Nature element/environment
[olist]
[*] 1 healing at the end of the turn
[*] 2 healing at the end of the turn
[*] 3 healing at the end of the turn
[/olist]
[*] Food/drink
[olist]
[*] Healing 50% attack power
[*] Healing 75% attack power
[*] Healing 100% attack power
[/olist]
[*] Organization/group
[olist]
[*] 1 card shares damage
[*] 2 cards share damage
[*] 3 cards share damage
[/olist]
[*] Artifact/creation
[olist]
[*] + 1 attack/life
[*] + 2 attack/life
[*] + 3 attack/life
[/olist]
[*] Unit of measurement
[olist]
[*] + 1 mana
[*] + 2 Mana
[*] + 3 Mana
[/olist]
[/list]

[h1][u] UX improvements
[/u][/h1]
[list]
[*] Hand cards are now at the bottom of the screen. When hovered, they come into the visible area. This prevents overlap with cards on the field
[*] Classes of the card are displayed directly when the card is hovered
[*] If there is a change in the life/attack of the card, this is now shown animatedly
[*] Number of possible words is now shown in the main menu
[/list]

[h1][u] 31 new words added
[/u][/h1]

notes.title: Version 0.1.31
notes.content:
[h3]Individual word cards are now created with costs:[/h3]

Rules:
Each player starts with one mana (maximum mana). Each round the maximum mana is increased by one and the mana is refilled.

notes.title: Version 0.1.30
notes.content:
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you could no longer play cards on fields where a card was once lying
[*] Bot opponents now continue playing even after a card has been destroyed
[*] Animation showing possible combinations is active again
[*] Action timer is now visible in the foreground again
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can no longer drag opponents' hand cards around
[*] Friend tiles from the invitation list of a private lobby are no longer displayed faded
[*] Search for ranked games is no longer called "search match" but "ranked match"
[*] 36 new words added
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.1.29
notes.content:
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ranking function has been fixed, ranking games should now be possible again
[*] Card details/card effect tooltips can now also be displayed with the new design of the hand cards
[*] When the turn ends, all active card effect tooltips are now hidden
[/list]

[h3]New functions[/h3]
[*] There is now a profile button in the main menu, here it is now possible to select a portrait (standard portraits or self-discovered cards/combinations). These are then displayed as portraits during the game
[*] If image generation fails, this will be tried again when a word is entered again in another game. This means that eventually there should be an image for every card.

notes.title: Some UX improvements and bug fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] If the game is closed during a match, the player now automatically gives up.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented input after a named word was entered
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented cards from being animated after a card attacked
[*] Larger dictionary is now available. Checking is more tolerant
[*] Word input now takes place at the beginning of the turn within a popup
[*] Discoveries are now shown in a feed, no longer centrally
[*] New card design for monsters
[*] UI optimized for different resolutions
[*] Depending on the point rating, you are now assigned to different leagues, previously only visually
[/list]
